verdict.rationale: RUN documents a built-in, AI-powered virtual assistant (adp-run-docs-16), but it is described only as answering payroll and HR questions, not as carrying out tasks for the user. The other AI features are narrow automations rather than an assistant you delegate to: AI timesheet import (adp-run-docs-17) and AI error flagging (adp-run-docs-3). ADP Assist (adp-run-docs-34) does perform developer tasks, but inside API Central rather than RUN's own interface. Missing for 10: evidence the assistant can take actions such as running payroll, adding employees or generating reports on request; any hands-on or independent corroboration of the assistant.
